verdict.rationale: Consensus is built as a scholarly search engine over 200 million academic papers rather than the open web. It analyzes full text, including paywalled papers from major publishers, and offers filters by study type and journal, a peer-reviewed-only option, and a Medical Mode limited to top journals and clinical guidelines. Every answer cites the original source. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of corpus coverage and source quality (all evidence is vendor-claimed).

support.subject: As a researcher, I can search scholarly literature and primary sources, not just the open web

citations.quote: It searches over 200 million academic papers and uses language models to help you find, understand, and synthesize the literature faster.
Consensus analyzes the full text, including paywalled papers from major publishers, so you can find the most relevant papers.
Filters allow narrowing by study type (RCT, meta-analysis, systematic review, observational), publication year, journal, open-access status, and discipline.
Clinicians often need insights drawn only from top medical journals and clinical guidelines — the gold standard of evidence.That's why we're introducing Medical Mode in Consensus.
Every response includes citations, so you can trace each insight back to the original source.
